note: THE MISSES, which are where these three names are easy to get wrong. Emacs answers (0 0 nil "abc" "abc" "abc"): the empty string is blank and so is a tab-and-newline one, so the predicate's character class is not just the space; a prefix or suffix that does not match answers the STRING ITSELF rather than nil; and an empty prefix removes nothing. u0-subr-x-string-helpers pins the hits.
